notes: Court order dated May 20, 2025 (Judge Padovano) set Present Need at 42 units and Fourth Round Prospective Need at 279 units. Planning Board adopted HEFSP on June 16, 2025. AHOZ-5A (supportive housing, 10 units, Block 1710 Lot 38), AHOZ-5B (age-restricted, 12 units, 3 affordable, Block 1710 Lot 38), and AHOZ-6 (inclusionary, max 220 units, Block 401 Lots 1/2.01/2.02/3/4/5, min 3.75 acres) are the key Round 4 overlay sites. notes: Settlement agreement with FSHC signed November 1, 2017 (by Mayor Cagas) and November 3, 2017. Fourth Round HEFSP adopted June 30, 2025, per township news page. Present Need: 7 rehabilitation units (to be addressed via Bergen County Home Improvement Program). Prospective Need: 174 units total; RDP = 4 units; Unmet Need = 170 units. RDP of 4 is based on Vacant Land Analysis. Two key Fourth Round sites identified: (1) Grove Street Overlay (Block 3, Lots 17.02 & 19) - 16 units total, 20% affordable set-aside, developer Eletherios Sakellaris proposed; (2) Route 46 District (Block 2.01, Lots 4.01, 4.02, 6.03, 6.04, 8.02, 8.04) - existing affordable housing overlay district, 15% set-aside. Area A Redevelopment (Route 46, 7.734 acres, 9 lots) declared area in need of redevelopment June 27, 2024, with RFP issued December 2024 for mixed-use transit-oriented development; this is aspirational unmet need mechanism.

notes: Planning Board adopted HEFSP June 16, 2025. DCA assigned Present Need 214 units, Prospective Need 431 units; Township determined its obligation as 384 units on January 30, 2025. Six redevelopment sites identified, projected to yield 83 total units generating ~124.5 affordable credits (with TOD/bonus mechanisms). March 15, 2026 final implementation deadline. Planning Board held public hearing on amended HEFSP on May 14, 2026. Amended HEFSP document posted at teanecknj.gov (2026). Ordinance 43-2025 (introduced December 9, 2025) establishes IH-1 Overlay at 827 Teaneck Road. Settlement date with FSHC for Fourth Round not confirmed. Cedar Lane/American Legion Drive project (Block 819 + others) is primary RDP site with 48 LMI units.
